description: Source code for the platform configuration management in Mattermost, including configuration handling, client config generation, asymmetric key management, and logging setup.

classes.name: ServiceConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for initializing the PlatformService, requiring a Store and optionally a Cluster interface.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Returns the current configuration object.

methods.name: getSanitizedConfig
methods.description: Returns a sanitized copy of the configuration, removing secrets.

methods.name: AddConfigListener
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when configuration is reloaded.

methods.name: RemoveConfigListener
methods.description: Removes a previously registered configuration listener.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration using a provided function.

methods.name: IsConfigReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the configuration store is read-only.

methods.name: SaveConfig
methods.description: Replaces the current configuration and optionally notifies cluster peers.

methods.name: ReloadConfig
methods.description: Reloads the configuration from persistent storage.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentOverridesWithFilter
methods.description: Returns environment-specific configuration overrides filtered by a provided function.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentOverrides
methods.description: Returns all environment-specific configuration overrides.

methods.name: DescribeConfig
methods.description: Returns a string description of the current configuration.

methods.name: CleanUpConfig
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations on the configuration store.

methods.name: ConfigureLogger
methods.description: Configures a logger with specified settings.

methods.name: GetConfigStore
methods.description: Returns the underlying configuration store.

methods.name: GetConfigFile
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration file by name.

methods.name: SetConfigFile
methods.description: Sets a configuration file with specified data.

methods.name: RemoveConfigFile
methods.description: Removes a configuration file by name.

methods.name: HasConfigFile
methods.description: Checks if a configuration file exists.

methods.name: SetConfigReadOnlyFF
methods.description: Sets the configuration store to read-only mode.

methods.name: ClientConfigHash
methods.description: Returns the hash of the client configuration.

methods.name: regenerateClientConfig
methods.description: Regenerates the client configuration, including asymmetric keys.

methods.name: AsymmetricSigningKey
methods.description: Returns the private key used for asymmetric signing.

methods.name: EnsureAsymmetricSigningKey
methods.description: Ensures an asymmetric signing key exists, generating one if necessary.

methods.name: LimitedClientConfigWithComputed
methods.description: Returns client config with additional computed properties.

methods.name: ClientConfigWithComputed
methods.description: Returns full client config with additional computed properties.

methods.name: LimitedClientConfig
methods.description: Returns the limited client configuration.

methods.name: IsFirstUserAccount
methods.description: Checks if the current user is the first account in the system.

methods.name: MaxPostSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed post size.

methods.name: isUpgradedFromTE
methods.description: Checks if the system was upgraded from TE.

methods.name: GetSystemInstallDate
methods.description: Retrieves the system installation date.

methods.name: ClientConfig
methods.description: Returns the current client configuration.
